thread-local txn buffer: commit flush / rollback discard
checkpoint keeps only committed, non-deleted rows
Session / isolation levels — read snapshot policy
① No dirty reads at any level — pendingTxn rows are owner-only
② RU → RC (+ read-only next txn), RR → SERIALIZABLE (HSQLDB)
③ RC = statement snapshot; RR/SER = txn snapshot + 40001
④ Commit is the only publication point for rows and WAL
OK / EOF report SERVER_STATUS_AUTOCOMMIT and SERVER_STATUS_IN_TRANS

START TRANSACTION ... LEVEL · SAVEPOINT / ROLLBACK TO / RELEASE
Expr = variant of Column / Literal / Call
eval(ctx, expr) — WHERE / HAVING / subquery IN
@@tx_isolation and @@autocommit resolve to the live Session state
setIsolation(): RU → RC (+ read-only next txn), RR → SERIALIZABLE
session default is persistent; SET TRANSACTION affects only the next txn
WalBufferScope routes the thread-local WAL buffer to the active session
SELECT / INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE use the session read snapshot
UPDATE = delete(old rid) + insert(new rid), 2 RowActions with own ids
SELECT takes zero locks; JOIN is O(N×M) nested loop (M6 P2: hash join)
commit: snapshot conflict check → commitSCN → finalize → WAL flush
rollback: reverse undo, restores PK index; uncommitted WAL discarded
rollback_to_savepoint: undo tail actions + truncate wal_buffer_
committed_queue_(commitSCN, owner, actions) feeds RR/SER conflicts
merge_expired_transactions drops entries when no live txn needs them
for_each_visible(querySCN, readerTxn): owner sees own pending writes
finalize_commit() at commit · AVL enforces the unique primary key
append() routes to the txn buffer; flush_txn_buffer() on commit only
Startup: sql.data snapshot → replay sql.wal → resume SCN counter
Snapshot uses for_each_visible(MAX_SCN); deleted rows never revived
READ UNCOMMITTED → READ COMMITTED (+ read-only when set for the next transaction)
READ COMMITTED (default) → statement-level snapshot, non-repeatable reads allowed
REPEATABLE READ → SERIALIZABLE → one transaction-level snapshot (SNAPSHOT ISOLATION)
SERIALIZABLE → stale / concurrent row writes abort with 40001 (MySQL errno 1213)
① JOIN is a pure nested loop O(N×M) — M6 P2 needs Index Nested Loop / Hash Join
② DESCRIBE / SHOW FULL TABLES not implemented (2 SQLAlchemy inspector checks fail)
